"""Bounded attempt-local duplicate admission; never source coverage or publication authority."""

from __future__ import annotations

DEFAULT_SAVED_EXPORT_MAX_IDENTITIES = 100_000


def require_export_identity_capacity(max_identities: int) -> None:
    """Apply the shared bounded budget to an actual attempt and durable queued intent."""
    if type(max_identities) is not int or not 1 <= max_identities <= 1_000_000:
        raise ValueError("export_identity_capacity")


class BatchExportIdentityLedger:
    """Keep exact selected identities until the owning export attempt ends."""

    def __init__(self, max_identities: int) -> None:
        require_export_identity_capacity(max_identities)
        self._capacity = max_identities
        self._accounts: set[str | int] = set()
        self._transactions: set[str | int] = set()
        self._account_type: type[str] | type[int] | None = None
        self._transaction_type: type[str] | type[int] | None = None
        self._failed = False

    @property
    def account_count(self) -> int:
        """Return identities observed, never a claim about unobserved source records."""
        return len(self._accounts)

    @property
    def transaction_count(self) -> int:
        """Return admitted transaction identities within this one attempt."""
        return len(self._transactions)

    def observe_account(self, identity: object) -> None:
        """Reject duplicate account identity across every selected source member."""
        self._observe(identity, transaction=False)

    def observe_transaction(self, identity: object) -> None:
        """Reject duplicate TransactionID across selected accounts and source members."""
        self._observe(identity, transaction=True)

    def require_nonempty(self) -> None:
        """Reject failed attempts and empty selected-account populations before publication."""
        if self._failed:
            raise ValueError("export_identity_failed")
        if not self._accounts:
            raise ValueError("export_selection_empty")

    def _observe(self, identity: object, *, transaction: bool) -> None:
        """Apply one exact identity rule to the two real entity admission paths.

        owning_context_or_shared_kernel: batch_exports
        owning_layer: domain
        rationale: Both account and transaction admission require the same bounded
            exact-value rule, combined capacity and permanent attempt failure.
        tests: test_batch_export_identity_ledger.py
        """
        if self._failed:
            raise ValueError("export_identity_failed")
        if type(identity) is int:
            valid = -(1 << 63) <= identity < (1 << 63)
        elif type(identity) is str:
            try:
                valid = 0 < len(identity.encode("utf-8")) <= 256
            except UnicodeError:
                valid = False
        else:
            valid = False
        if not valid:
            self._failed = True
            raise ValueError("export_identity_value")
        assert isinstance(identity, str | int)
        observed = self._transactions if transaction else self._accounts
        identity_type = self._transaction_type if transaction else self._account_type
        if identity_type is not None and type(identity) is not identity_type:
            self._failed = True
            raise ValueError("export_identity_mixed_type")
        if identity in observed:
            self._failed = True
            raise ValueError("export_identity_duplicate")
        if len(self._accounts) + len(self._transactions) >= self._capacity:
            self._failed = True
            raise ValueError("export_identity_capacity")
        observed.add(identity)
        if transaction:
            self._transaction_type = type(identity)
        else:
            self._account_type = type(identity)


def make_batch_export_identity_ledger(*, max_identities: int) -> BatchExportIdentityLedger:
    """Sole construction site; caller must explicitly select the bounded attempt budget."""
    return BatchExportIdentityLedger(max_identities)
